subject.name: Saint Hildegard of Bingen, Abbess and Doctor of the Church
subject.blurb: A twelfth-century Benedictine abbess who founded monasteries near Bingen, preached across Germany, and recorded her visions in Scivias. Her surviving works range across theology, medicine, natural science, and sacred music; Pope Benedict XVI named her a Doctor of the Church in 2012.
